subject: Citrine Labs: Legal Entity Snapshot & PO Routing — action items
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@citrinelabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Citrine Labs: Legal Entity Snapshot & PO Routing — action items

Alex,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday. To finish provisioning Citrine Labs in our vendor registry and enable PO issuance, we need a short legal entity snapshot and confirmation of your PO/remit preferences. Can you please provide the following by EOD Friday?

- Legal business name (as on invoices)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (or VAT registration if outside US)
- Remit address for paper checks
- AP contact name, email, phone
- Preferred PO receipt method (email to ap@citrinelabs.com, EDI, vendor portal)
- Bank account type for ACH (we'll send secure link for capture)

I've attached our onboarding packet which includes the supplier snapshot template — if you can fill the 'Supplier Snapshot' tab and return with any supporting docs that will speed setup.

I'll loop Ben for payment-channel questions and Karthik for any PO mapping issues.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Redwood_Onboarding_Packet_v1.pdf (supplier snapshot template)

From: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@citrinelabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 10:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Citrine Labs: Legal Entity Snapshot & PO Routing — action items

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — appreciate the checklist. Please find the completed Supplier Snapshot attached (Citrine_Supplier_Snapshot.xlsx). A couple of quick clarifications below:

1) Tax form: Citrine is US-based and we'll attach a signed W-9 (attached). Is that sufficient or do you need any additional certifications?
2) PO method: Our system can receive POs by email (ap@citrinelabs.com) and via EDI. We prefer EDI but can accept email in the interim — is your AP team able to process emailed PDF POs?
3) Bank capture: We'll await your secure link to submit ACH details. In the meantime, is there any vendor-number format we should populate on our side for remittance reconciliation?

I've cc'd procurement@citrinelabs.com for visibility. Let me know if anything else is missing.

Best,

Alex Garcia
Head of Finance Operations
Citrine Labs
alex.garcia@citrinelabs.com
(650) 555-3429

Attachments: Citrine_Supplier_Snapshot.xlsx, Citrine_W9_signed.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Citrine Labs: Legal Entity Snapshot & PO Routing — action items

Thanks Alex — received attachments and looks good on first pass.

On your questions:

- W-9 is sufficient for US vendors. Ben (cc'd) will follow up if we need additional tax docs.
- We can accept emailed PDF POs to ap@redwood.com. Karthik, for EDI what format/partner onboarding is required on your side?
- Vendor number: we'll provision a Redwood vendor id and share it back (format: RW-####). Please populate your systems with the vendor legal name and our vendor id when we send it.

Next steps:
1) Ben to confirm AP email handling and any PO field requirements (invoice remittance vs remit-only addresses).
2) We'll provision Citrine in the vendor registry and send the RW vendor id + secure ACH capture link by end of day Friday.

Alex — if you can confirm the AP email and that you can receive PDF POs, we'll start the provisioning.

Thanks,

Marissa

Alex,

Quick AP note from our side:

- We will accept emailed PDF POs at ap@redwood.com and ingest them into our PO system. Please ensure each PO includes: our legal payee name (Redwood Inference Inc.), Citrine's invoice remit address, PO number, line-item unit prices, and payment terms.
- ACH: Marissa will send a secure capture link (we use a tokenized form). Do not send bank account numbers over email.
- Vendor id: we'll assign RW-1024 for Citrine and notify you once provisioning is complete. Please add that to your remittance reference field to speed matching.
- For EDI: we currently support ANSI X12 850 PO inbound; if you want to go EDI we'll schedule a small onboarding with our integration team. That usually takes 2–3 weeks.

Marissa — flagging AP exceptions: if Citrine needs net-30 vs net-45 please indicate on the Supplier Snapshot so we can set terms.

Alex — happy to jump on a 15-min call if you'd like to walk through field requirements.

Regards,
